panels.title: Block Rounds Missed vs Block Time

panels.description:
Sum all missed rounds and group by block proposer. 

Shows that the biggest contributor to potential round issues is the block contents that can't be processed in time, no matter which proposer it was.

Count and sum of all skipped signatures as reported in the last commit. Means that validator didn't get a valid proposal in time or proposal was invalid. This is grouped by proposer. 

Lastly, it shows % of skipped signatures per proposer's block.

So, this shows slow proposers.
